theo.author: visitor
theo.body: Hi there! I've been feeling lost about my career path lately and could really use some guidance.

theo.author: reader
theo.body: I completely understand that feeling. Let's explore what the universe has in store for your professional journey.

theo.author: reader
theo.body: I'm pulling some cards now to see what energy surrounds your career path.

theo.author: reader
theo.body: The Tower card has appeared — big changes are coming, but they will lead to something beautiful.

theo.author: visitor
theo.body: That's intense! Should I be worried about the Tower card?

theo.author: reader
theo.body: Not at all, sweetheart! The Tower alongside the Star means transformation followed by hope and renewal.

theo.author: reader
theo.body: You will be surprised how quickly things align once you release the fear of change.

solomon.author: visitor
solomon.body: Hello Solomon, I have a question about my relationship. Things have been rocky lately.

solomon.author: reader
solomon.body: Welcome, dear one. Relationships are mirrors — let me look into what the cards reveal about yours.

solomon.author: reader
solomon.body: I sense a strong emotional bond but also some unspoken tensions that need addressing.

solomon.author: reader
solomon.body: The Lovers card paired with the Five of Cups tells me there is love, but grief over unmet expectations.

solomon.author: visitor
solomon.body: That resonates so much. What should I do about it?

solomon.author: reader
solomon.body: Solomon may know an answer to your question. As the Empress card shows, nurturing honest communication will restore balance.

solomon.author: reader
solomon.body: The path forward requires vulnerability from both sides. The Six of Cups suggests revisiting what first brought you together.
